vacancies.title: Fullstack Developer (Laravel + React)
vacancies.description:
## The stack, and why we are not strict about it
Our largest engagement is a Laravel API with a Filament admin and a React Native client. Others run on Python and on TypeScript with React. New engagements arrive with the stack already chosen, by the client or by whoever built the first version, and you do not get to pick which one you land on.
So the language on your CV matters less to us than whether you can be dropped into a codebase you did not write and be useful in it within a couple of weeks. We would rather hire someone with deep PHP and workable TypeScript who has done that twice than someone who has only ever worked in one framework.

## How we work
Every change starts as a written specification with acceptance criteria. A person reviews the charter, the plan, and the demo. Tests are written first and ship with the change, not after it. CI stays green on main.
If a specification is ambiguous, we expect you to say so before you implement it, and that counts as doing the job correctly, not as blocking the work.

## What you will do

- Implement product features against approved specifications on live client engagements.

- Write and maintain the automated tests that go with each change, as part of finishing it.

- Review other engineers’ changes against the specification and the project’s own rules.

- Move between engagements and stacks as work demands, without a long ramp each time.

- Work directly with US product leadership on requirements and demos. Nobody translates for you.

## What we need

- 3+ years building and shipping production web applications.

- Real depth in at least one server-side language. PHP with Laravel is the most useful to us today. Python and Node also count.

- Working competence in a second language or framework, and at least one time you picked up a codebase in something you had not shipped in before. We will ask you about that specifically.

- TypeScript and React on the front end.

- Relational database design and the ability to work out why a query is slow.

- AWS.

- Test discipline. You should be able to describe how you decide what to test and what you deliberately leave untested.

- English at B2 or above, written and spoken. You will be on calls with US clients and the US team directly. This is a functional requirement of the role.

## Useful, not required

- Filament, Livewire, or a comparable admin layer over Laravel.

- React Native and Expo. There is mobile work, but it is not the whole job.

- Healthcare or other regulated software: HIPAA, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, or comparable.

- Next.js, Drizzle or a similar typed ORM.

- Working alongside AI coding tools inside a reviewed process rather than ad hoc.

## Employment

- Location: Remote from Ukraine or Poland

- Employment type: B2B or employment contract, confirmed at offer

- Compensation: Based on the candidate’s level and discussed during the first call.

vacancies.title: Full-stack Software Engineer
vacancies.description:
## About YouScan
YouScan.io is one of the most successful Ukrainian SaaS companies. Our deep tech product, powered by in-house developed AI technology, is one of the leaders in the social listening space globally. The entire engineering department works on collecting billions of social media posts daily, processing them with cutting-edge technologies, and providing meaningful insights to our customers.
We are a creative, low-ego, team-spirited company. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truthseeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

We really value innovation, bottom-up ideas, and execution.

We hold company-wide hackathons twice a year:
medium.com/...​f-hackathons-85a99081d8cf

We’re in-person in a cozy office in central Kyiv with a beautiful terrace overlooking the historic center.

## About the role
You’ll join a small, self-contained squad building analytics products with and for some of the world’s largest consumer brands.
These products are greenfield builds with real users on the other side from day one. The brand partner sees what you ship, and the feedback loop is short, sometimes uncomfortably so. That’s the appeal of the role, and it’s also the bar.

## Responsibilities:

- Build and ship features on a new product, from the ground up

- Own your work end to end: UI, API, data model, tests, deployment, and whatever breaks at 6pm on a Thursday.

- Work directly with the project manager to turn a partner’s vague ideas into a smooth user experience

- Pull, blend, and model data from multiple sources — our own social listening pipeline plus partner-supplied datasets that will never arrive in the shape you’d like.

- Contribute to technical decisions and help shape the product’s overall architecture.

vacancies.title: IT & Development Manager / AI Tech Lead
vacancies.description:
Юридична компанія Приходько та Партнери в пошуках універсального IT-спеціаліста (IT & Development Manager / AI Tech Lead), який відповідатиме за IT-інфраструктуру компанії, розвиток CRM, AI-автоматизацію, технічну підтримку та координацію IT-підрядників.
Нам потрібна людина, яка може самостійно розібратися в проблемі, вирішити її або залучити відповідного спеціаліста та проконтролювати результат.
Основні обов’язки:
1. CRM та розробка

- Керування розробкою та розвитком CRM.

- Формування ТЗ, постановка задач та контроль виконання.

- Координація розробників і тестування нового функціоналу.

- Самостійна розробка невеликих задач та MVP за допомогою Cursor / Claude Code / Codex.

- Розробка внутрішніх сервісів, інтеграцій та автоматизацій.

- Робота з Git/GitHub, API, n8n / Make.

2. Системне адміністрування

- Адміністрування VPS, Linux, Docker, Nginx.

- Робота з доменами, DNS, SSL, Cloudflare.

- Контроль працездатності сайтів, серверів та внутрішніх систем.

- Управління доступами співробітників.

3. Backup та технічна безпека

- Регулярне резервне копіювання сайтів, CRM, баз даних та серверів.

- Контроль успішності backup.

- Періодична перевірка можливості відновлення даних.

- Контроль доступів та 2FA.

4. Телефонія

- Технічний контроль роботи Ringostat та UniTalk.

- Контроль вхідних/вихідних дзвінків та інтеграції з CRM.

- Налаштування користувачів, номерів, переадресацій.

- Взаємодія з техпідтримкою та контроль усунення несправностей.

5. Інтернет та відеоспостереження

- Контроль працездатності Інтернету, Wi-Fi та локальної мережі.

- Базова діагностика проблем та комунікація з провайдером.

- Контроль технічної працездатності камер відеоспостереження та запису.

- Виклик підрядника та контроль усунення несправностей.

6. IT-підтримка співробітників

- Технічна підтримка співробітників компанії.

- Налаштування комп’ютерів та смартфонів.

- Створення корпоративної пошти та необхідних облікових записів.

- Налаштування Apple ID, Telegram, Viber, WhatsApp та інших робочих месенджерів.

- Підключення корпоративного номера, Ringostat / UniTalk та CRM.

- Налаштування необхідного ПЗ та 2FA.

- Надання та відкликання доступів при прийнятті/звільненні співробітників.

7. Робота з підрядниками

- Комунікація з IT-підрядниками, розробниками та технічною підтримкою сервісів.

- Постановка задач та передача ТЗ.

- Контроль термінів, якості та результату.

- Приймання виконаних робіт та контроль виправлення помилок.

Що важливо від кандидата:

- Досвід роботи з CRM та веброзробкою.

- Розуміння Linux, VPS, Docker, DNS, SSL.

- Розуміння API, інтеграцій та автоматизацій.

- Досвід роботи з Git/GitHub.

- Практичне використання AI-інструментів для розробки.

- Здатність самостійно знаходити та вирішувати технічні проблеми.

- Системність, відповідальність та уважність.

- Вміння комунікувати з підрядниками та контролювати їхню роботу.

Ключова вимога — ми шукаємо не класичного сисадміна, а технічного універсала, який зможе поєднувати:
IT Infrastructure + CRM Development + AI/Vibe Coding + Automation + Technical Support + Contractor Management.

Fuelfinance is on a mission to revolutionize financial management for early-stage startups, empowering them to take control of their finances and thrive. Kim (SendBird), Stratmind, and Bad Ideas funds, following 3 years of profitable, bootstrapped success. fuelfinance.me
www.instagram.com/fuelfinance
youtu.be/eI5VH2Ks9o4

## Who are we searching for?
We’re looking for an Engineering Team Lead to build and lead a new engineering team working on a new enterprise product line on top of the Fuelfinance AI finance platform.
This is a player-coach role: roughly half of your time is hands-on engineering, the other half is leading — architecture, planning, hiring, and growing people. You start with a team of one senior engineer and help hire the rest. You are the technical decision-maker for this direction and are accountable for what it ships.

## The team
You’ll build a new team inside R&D. You’ll report to the Head of Engineering and work closely with the core product team (5 engineers, 1 QA), the Product Director, and the C-level team.

## What will you build?

- A new enterprise product line on top of the Fuelfinance platform (details are shared during the interview process)

- The architecture that lets it reuse and extend the core platform: AI finance agents, MCP infrastructure and agent orchestration, integrations with accounting platforms, banks, and payment systems (QuickBooks, Xero, Stripe), access controls, and reporting

- The team itself: hiring, onboarding, engineering practices, and standards

## What are your responsibilities?

- Lead a small engineering team as a player-coach — ~50% hands-on coding and reviews, ~50% architecture, planning, and people

- Own the architecture of the product line — make and defend design decisions, keep them aligned with the core platform, drive System Design Reviews

- Own delivery and be accountable for outcomes — plan, estimate, raise risks early, ship fast without cutting corners that matter

- Hold the quality bar — testing strategy, code review standards, observability, and incident response are your responsibility

- Hire and grow the team — take part in hiring, run 1:1s, give regular feedback, develop engineers along our seniority grading

- Be a product partner — work directly with the Product Director and stakeholders, understand customer problems, push back on scope when needed

- Set the standard for AI-native engineering — agentic coding workflows, proper codebase context, end-to-end verification — and make it the team’s default

- Keep security and data integrity at the core of everything — we handle customers’ financial data

- Protect the team’s culture — ownership, direct communication, honest feedback

## What are the preferred requirements for the role?

- 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading a team with real accountability for delivery

- Experience building products or systems from scratch and taking them to production with a small team

- Proficiency with AI-assisted development (a must) — not just chat-based usage: you build agentic coding workflows, feed the right codebase context to models, and verify AI output with end-to-end testing

- Proficiency in both frontend and backend development

- TypeScript, Node.js (Nest.js), React

- SQL, MongoDB

- AWS knowledge

- Strong system design skills — you design for scale, security, and maintainability and can explain trade-offs to non-engineers

- Experience hiring and mentoring engineers

- Experience enhancing system and infrastructure security

- B2/C1 English level

- Comfortable with startup mode: shifting priorities, fast pace, high ownership

## Will be a plus:

- Experience with LLM APIs in production (Anthropic, OpenAI), RAG, agents, or evals

- Fintech background or experience on security-focused projects

- Knowledge of one of the following: Go, Python

- Early-stage startup experience

- Experience with infrastructure setup

## Recruitment Process:

- CV & Cover Letter check

- Soft skills interview

- System Design & Experience Review

- Leadership & Management interview

- Culture fit interview

## Why work with us?

- Build a new product line from day one — architecture, team, and practices are yours to shape

- Real leadership scope early — you own a direction and work directly with the Product Director and C-level

- Build the future of finance work — design AI-native finance products, not just maintain them

- Rapid skills improvement

- Growth opportunities according to our seniority grading (it comes with a compensation increase)

- Flexible schedule and time-off policy

- 18 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leaves

Who and what we are after?

- Solid backend development experience in Python, or a comparable server-side language, with the ability to design and own services from the ground up.

- Experience working with distributed systems and microservice architectures at scale.

- Ability to work independently with a high degree of autonomy, taking initiative and driving outcomes without close direction.

- Exceptional attention to detail and a genuine, deep commitment to software quality.

- Familiarity with DevOps practices and containerisation technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) in cloud-based environments.

- Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, with hands-on experience across modern frontend frameworks (Angular, Vue, React, or equivalent) and contemporary build tooling.

Nice to have

vacancies.title: Backend Engineer (Node.js + Python)
vacancies.description:
We are looking for a Backend Engineer, middle level or above. Our backend is an event-driven system of microservices that connects customer channels with AI agents in real time: from a WhatsApp message to streaming an LLM reply into the chat widget. The business layer is built with Node.js, the AI layer with Python and LangGraph. The most interesting tasks live where these two meet, so we need someone with hands-on experience in both languages.
About Intelswift
Intelswift is an AI-native platform for customer service automation. We build a product where AI doesn’t just answer questions, it does real work:

- AI agents for chat and email

- Voice AI agents

- AI Copilot for support agents

- Omnichannel support

- Knowledge base and AI analytics

We move fast, avoid bureaucracy, and use AI in our daily work.
Tech side: microservices on Node.js (Express) and AI services on Python (asyncio). The AI layer is built on LangGraph, with LangSmith for tracing and LiteLLM for model routing; RAG runs on vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant). Services talk through Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ and gRPC, realtime goes over WebSocket and SSE, data lives in MongoDB. Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, AWS and Azure.
What you’ll do:

- Build and develop Node.js microservices.

- Design and evolve AI agents on LangGraph: agent graphs, multi-agent swarms, tool calling, RAG.

- Trace and evaluate agent behavior with LangSmith: answer quality, latency, cost.

- Tasks at the border of the two stacks: Kafka contracts and gRPC between Node.js services and Python workers.

- Event-driven logic: retries, DLQ, idempotency.

- Realtime for the dashboard and widgets: WebSocket, SSE.

- Integrations: WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Viber, Messenger, Stripe, MCP.

- Deploy services to Kubernetes. Later on, help prepare the platform for on-prem installations and the move to local STT/TTS/LLM models.

What we expect:

- 3+ years of commercial backend development, solid production experience with both Node.js and Python (one of them can be your main language).

- Python: async stack (asyncio/aiohttp), our AI services are fully async.

- Hands-on experience with LangGraph or a similar agent framework: agents with tools, state and memory.

- MongoDB: indexes, aggregations (Mongoose).

- Message brokers (Kafka and/or RabbitMQ): consumer groups, retries, DLQ.

- Redis: pub/sub or Streams.

- Realtime on the backend: WebSocket and/or SSE.

- Basic understanding of gRPC and protobuf.

- Kubernetes as a confident user.

- English B2+, Ukrainian C2.

Nice to have:

- Helm and experience with on-prem or self-hosted installations.

- Experience with local STT/TTS/LLM models.

- TypeScript, Temporal.

- Voice tech: WebRTC, SIP, telephony.

- Experience with billing systems (Stripe).

- Experience with multi-tenant B2B SaaS.

Required languages English B2 — Upper Intermediate Ukrainian C2 — Proficient
What we offer:

- Real impact on the architecture of a product used by real customers.

- Work with modern AI technologies: multi-agent systems, LLMs, voice agents, RAG.

- Remote-first culture with async communication.

- Minimum bureaucracy, maximum ownership.

- Flexible schedule with focus on results, not hours worked.

- Paid vacation and sick leave.

- Competitive compensation.

vacancies.title: Спеціаліст / юрист з міжнародного оподаткування
vacancies.description:

- Розробка міжнародних холдингових, операційних та IP-структур (Кіпр, ОАЕ, ЄС, США, Португалія та інші юрисдикції)

- Приватні клієнти: релокація, податкове резидентство, non-dom режими

- Податковий супровід M&A та реорганізацій: tax due diligence, структурування угод

- Вміння писати структуровано: висновок → підстава → ризик → рекомендація

Буде перевагою

- Досвід в fintech, IT-секторі

Ми пропонуємо

- Проєкти, а не потік: складні багатоюрисдикційні структури, а не типові реєстрації

- Прямий доступ до клієнта та до партнерів фірми

## Ключові вимоги і навички

- Вища освіта

vacancies.title: Computer Vision Engineer (OCR)
vacancies.description:
About Farsight Vision:
Farsight Vision develops AI-powered geospatial intelligence solutions for defence and security operations. The platform transforms raw aerial and sensor data into real-time 3D environments, actionable analytics, and AI-assisted operational scenarios, enabling enhanced situational awareness, mission planning, and faster decision-making for both human operators and autonomous systems. We operate at the intersection of geospatial data, computer vision, and defense operations — and if that interests you, read on.
We are looking for a Robotics Engineer to own motion control for our unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) end-to-end — from control theory on paper to a robot that actually moves the way you designed it to. This is not a role for someone who wants control loops handed to them pre-tuned: you will design, implement, and validate them on hardware yourself

Responsibilities:
— Implement navigation and control algorithms for different types of UGVs: differential drive, tracked wheels, Ackermann steering, etc
— Design and implement control algorithms (PID and beyond) that translate navigation commands into reliable robot motion
— Own the control stack end-to-end — from algorithm design through tuning and validation on the physical unit
— Simulate physical driving for different types of wheels and terrains before deploying to hardware
— Work closely with the Robotics team on actuator and sensor integration, since control quality is only as good as what it’s built on
— Debug control issues that only show up in the field, not in simulation — this role is hands-on with the physical robot in Lviv
— Collaborate with the Perception Engineer so control decisions correctly account for obstacle and environment data
— Propose architecture and design decisions rather than waiting to be handed a fully-scoped ticket: this is a small team building a new capability almost no one in the Ukrainian market has shipped yet

Requirements:
— Strong mathematical foundation: linear algebra, calculus, and the algorithmic thinking control systems are built on
— Practical experience with control theory — PID control at minimum, ideally more advanced control approaches
— Background in robotics, guidance, or navigation systems (e.g., autonomous vehicle guidance, drone terminal guidance, or similar)
— Experience with physics simulators (e.g. Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac, MATLAB, Simulink), with the ability to simulate dynamic models and verify controller performance before deployment
— Experience working with sensors such as IMU, LiDAR, etc.
— Knowledge of state estimation and filtering (e.g. Kalman filter, extended Kalman filter, complementary filter)
— Solid programming skills in C++ (and Python for prototyping)
— Good OOP skills — ability to write and design clean code that’s flexible to extend and maintain
— Comfortable working close to hardware, not purely in a software abstraction layer
— Upper-Intermediate+ English

Nice to have:
— Experience with ROS/ROS2
— Path planning algorithms (A*, D*, RRT, etc.)
— Prior work on UAV or UGV guidance/navigation systems
— Defense-tech or military-tech industry exposure
— Embedded systems or hardware-adjacent experience

Security Eligibility
Our platform is actively used by the Armed Forces in live operations. As an Estonian-Ukrainian defence technology company handling sensitive operational data, we have a responsibility — legal, ethical, and practical — to ensure the integrity of everyone on our team.
All candidates must be able to confirm the following:
Neither you nor your close relatives (parents, spouse, siblings, children) reside in Russia, Belarus, or temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories
You have no regular personal, financial, business, or professional contact with individuals in those territories
You consent to a deeper security verification if the process advances to later stages
If any of the above criteria are not met, please do not proceed with your application.

Why Farsight Vision
We are a startup operating under real-world conditions — our product is in active deployment, and the pace reflects that. We are not a company where you get to run the same experiment three times until it’s elegant — we need someone who wants to see their control loop working on a real robot within weeks, not quarters, and who is motivated by the fact that what you build here gets used, not shelved.
Flexible working hours. Paid vacation and sick leave. Direct access to founders and leadership.
Application Process
— Apply with your CV and a brief cover letter explaining your interest and relevant experience
— Complete a short practical assignment involving a control/navigation problem drawn from our platform
— Interview with the Recruiter and Lead Robotics Engineer

Що пропонуємо ми?

Надсилай своє резюме, і ми з радістю розглянемо твою кандидатуру. Чекаємо на тебе у нашому командному челенджі!

vacancies.description:
Join a project where data consistency, analytics scalability, and AI readiness are treated as core business priorities. We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build an AI-first semantic layer that standardizes business metrics across dashboards, reporting systems, analytical products, and AI-driven applications.
You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders and engineering teams to transform raw data into governed business meaning that can be trusted across the organization.
We at Sigma Software offer the opportunity to contribute to large-scale AdTech and analytics initiatives, work with modern data platforms, and influence the future of self-service analytics and AI-powered reporting solutions.
CUSTOMER
Our Customer is a leading technology company operating in the AdTech and digital monetization domain. The company develops scalable self-service advertising and analytics solutions used by enterprise clients worldwide to manage campaigns, reporting, and monetization workflows. The environment combines large-scale data processing, analytics engineering, and AI-driven innovation, with a strong focus on trusted metrics, reporting consistency, and data governance.
PROJECT
The project focuses on building an AI-first semantic layer that standardizes and governs business metrics across analytics platforms, dashboards, reporting systems, and AI-powered applications. The team is developing canonical analytical models to ensure that concepts such as revenue, impressions, campaigns, and advertiser activity are consistently defined and reusable across the organization.
The initiative combines semantic modeling, modern data transformation practices, BI enablement, and AI/LLM-oriented data preparation. The goal is to establish a scalable analytics foundation that supports self-service analytics, trusted reporting, and future customer-facing analytical products.
RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and implement scalable semantic modeling approaches for enterprise analytics

- Build canonical analytical models on top of the core data platform

- Define and govern business metrics together with Finance, Product, Ad Operations, Sales, and other stakeholders

- Translate business definitions into robust and tested technical implementations

- Develop reusable semantic models consumable by BI tools, analytical products, and AI agents

- Create and maintain dashboards and analytical solutions for internal stakeholders

- Reconcile critical metrics across operational systems, reporting platforms, and financial data

- Implement automated testing for metrics, transformations, and business rules

- Maintain documentation, metadata, and lineage for business definitions and analytical assets

- Contribute to establishing company-wide data standardization processes

- Design intuitive datasets optimized for analyst workflows and machine consumption

- Support the evolution of self-service analytics capabilities

- Ensure governed metric definitions are consistently used across internal and customer-facing reporting systems

REQUIREMENTS

- At least 5 years of experience in Analytics Engineering or Data Engineering

- Strong background in analytics engineering, data modeling, or business intelligence engineering

- Advanced SQL skills

- Commercial experience with dbt or similar modern data transformation frameworks

- Strong understanding of dimensional, canonical, and semantic modeling concepts

- Experience building production-grade BI solutions and analytical products

- Experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders to define business metrics and KPIs

- Strong understanding of data quality validation, testing, and reconciliation processes

- Ability to transform ambiguous business concepts into clear technical definitions

- Hands-on experience implementing semantic or metrics layers

- Experience in SaaS or AdTech domains

- Experience working with modern cloud-based data platforms and scalable analytics architectures

- At least an Upper-Intermediate level of English

WILL BE A PLUS

- Finance and revenue reconciliation experience

- Experience with multi-tenant analytics environments

- Hands-on experience preparing structured data and metadata for AI/LLM consumption

- Experience building customer-facing analytics and reporting solutions

PERSONAL PROFILE

- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

- Detail-oriented approach to data quality and business consistency

- Proactive communication and collaboration skills

- Ownership mindset and focus on long-term scalability

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Приєднуйся до проєкту, де узгодженість даних, масштабованість аналітики та готовність до штучного інтелекту є ключовими бізнес-пріоритетами. Ми шукаємо Senior Analytics Engineer, який допоможе побудувати семантичний шар із першочерговим фокусуванням на AI, щоб стандартизувати бізнес-метрики для дашбордів, систем звітності, аналітичних продуктів та додатків на базі AI.
Ти тісно співпрацюватимеш із кросфункціональними стейкхолдерами та інженерними командами, щоб перетворювати сирі дані на керовані бізнес-сутності, яким можна довіряти в межах усієї організації.
У Sigma Software ти матимеш можливість долучитися до масштабних AdTech та аналітичних ініціатив, працювати з сучасними платформами даних та впливати на майбутнє самообслуговуваної аналітики і звітів на основі штучного інтелекту.
ЗАМОВНИК
Наш Клієнт — це провідна технологічна компанія, що працює у сфері AdTech та цифрової монетизації. Компанія розробляє масштабовані рекламні рішення із самообслуговуванням та аналітичні платформи, якими користуються корпоративні клієнти по всьому світу для керування кампаніями, звітності та робочих процесів монетизації. Середовище поєднує в собі обробку даних великих обсягів, інженерію даних та інновації на базі штучного інтелекту з особливим фокусом на надійність метрик, узгодженість звітності та управління даними.
ПРОЄКТ
Проєкт зосереджений на створенні семантичного шару з акцентом на штучний інтелект, який стандартизує та керує бізнес-метриками на платформах аналітики, у дашбордах, системах звітності та додатках на базі AI. Команда розробляє канонічні аналітичні моделі, щоб такі поняття, як дохід, показники рекламних матеріалів, кампанії та активність рекламодавців, мали чітке й узгоджене визначення та були багаторазово використаними в межах усієї організації.
Ця ініціатива поєднує семантичне моделювання, сучасні практики трансформації даних, розвиток бізнес-аналітики та підготовку даних, орієнтовану на AI/LLM. Мета полягає в тому, щоб створити масштабовану аналітичну основу, яка підтримує самообслуговувану аналітику, надійну звітність та майбутні аналітичні продукти для клієнтів.
ОБОВ’ЯЗКИ

- Розробляти та впроваджувати масштабовані підходи до семантичного моделювання для корпоративної аналітики

- Створювати канонічні аналітичні моделі поверх базової платформи даних

- Визначати бізнес-метрики та керувати ними спільно з командами Finance, Product, Ad Operations, Sales та іншими стейкхолдерами

- Перетворювати бізнес-вимоги на надійні й протестовані технічні рішення

- Розробляти багаторазові семантичні моделі для BI-інструментів, аналітичних продуктів та AI-агентів

- Створювати та підтримувати дашборди й аналітичні рішення для внутрішніх стейкхолдерів

- Узгоджувати критичні метрики між операційними системами, платформами звітності та фінансовими даними

- Впроваджувати автоматизоване тестування для метрик, трансформацій та бізнес-правил

- Вести документацію, метадані та родоводи даних для бізнес-визначень і аналітичних активів.

- Долучатися до побудови процесів стандартизації даних на рівні всієї компанії

- Проєктувати інтуїтивні набори даних, оптимізовані для роботи аналітиків та споживання машинними алгоритмами

- Сприяти розвитку можливостей самообслуговуваної аналітики

- Забезпечувати узгоджене використання керованих визначень метрик як у внутрішніх, так і в клієнтських системах звітності

ВИМОГИ

- Щонайменше 5 років досвіду в Analytics Engineering або Data Engineering

- Сильна експертиза в аналітичній інженерії, моделюванні даних або інженерії бізнес-аналітики

- Впевнене володіння SQL

- Комерційний досвід роботи з dbt або подібними сучасними фреймворками трансформації даних

- Глибоке розуміння концепцій вимірного, канонічного та семантичного моделювання

- Досвід створення BI-рішень промислового рівня та аналітичних продуктів

- Досвід співпраці з нетехнічними стейкхолдерами для визначення бізнес-метрик і KPI

- Глибоке розуміння процесів перевірки якості даних, тестування та звірки

- Здатність перетворювати бізнес-концепти на чіткі технічні визначення

- Практичний досвід впровадження семантичних шарів або шарів метрик

- Досвід роботи у SaaS або AdTech-доменах

- Досвід роботи із сучасними хмарними платформами даних та масштабованими аналітичними архітектурами

- Рівень англійської від Upper-Intermediate та вище

БУДЕ ПЕРЕВАГОЮ

- Досвід звірки фінансових даних та метрик доходу

- Досвід роботи в multi-tenant аналітичних середовищах

- Практичний досвід підготовки структурованих даних і метаданих для споживання штучним інтелектом

- Досвід створення клієнтоорієнтованих аналітичних рішень та систем звітності

ОСОБИСТИЙ ПРОФІЛЬ

- Сильне аналітичне мислення та підхід, орієнтований на розв’язання проблем

- Здатність працювати самостійно в динамічному середовищі

- Уважність до якості даних та узгодженості бізнес-логіки

- Проактивні комунікаційні навички та вміння працювати в команді

- Відповідальність і фокус на довгостроковій масштабованості

vacancies.title: Full-Stack Developer
Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer
vacancies.description:
## About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to turn validated proofs of concept, experimental scripts, and early-stage AI or automation solutions into secure, scalable, and reliable production applications.
You will take ownership of solutions end-to-end: from understanding business needs and shaping requirements to architecture, full-stack development, cloud deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.
The role combines modern full-stack engineering, Python backend development, cloud-native architecture, and applied AI. You will build web applications, APIs, integrations, automation workflows, and agentic AI systems using technologies such as LangChain and LangGraph.
You will work closely with the CTO Office, FinOps, Operations, Sales, and Pre-Sales teams to turn loosely defined ideas into practical products that automate manual work and deliver measurable operational value.
Initial initiatives may include FinOps automation, enterprise AI enablement, meeting assistants, internal productivity tools, and other AI-powered platforms.
This is an end-to-end engineering role with a high degree of ownership. You will be expected to make pragmatic technical decisions, work independently, and operate solutions in production without relying on dedicated QA, DevOps, or SRE support for everyday delivery.

## Technical Stack

- Languages & Frameworks: Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask), TypeScript, Vue.js, React, Nuxt.js, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS

- AI & Agentic Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, Multi-agent Orchestration, LLM Tool/Function Calling, MCP Servers, AI Skills

- Cloud & Serverless: AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, DynamoDB, S3, RDS, API Gateway), Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry

- Data & Architecture: REST APIs, Relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL Databases

- IaC & DevOps: GitHub Actions (Automated AI-assisted PR reviews), AWS CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation, Docker, Kubernetes

- Observability & Operations: CloudWatch, Prometheus, ELK Stack

- Security & Auth: OAuth 2.0, SAML, JWT, SSL/TLS, Secret Management

- Agentic Dev Tools: Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf.

## As a qualified expert, You will:

- Turn Concepts into Reality: Transform CTO Office proofs of concept, scripts, and experimental solutions into scalable, production-ready applications.

- Drive Full Product Lifecycle: Own projects end-to-end — from initial discovery and system architecture to deployment, ongoing support, and iterative improvements.

- Bridge Tech and Business: Collaborate directly with the CTO Office, FinOps, operations, sales, and pre-sales stakeholders to translate loosely defined business needs into concrete technical designs.

- Architect Modern Platforms: Build responsive frontends, robust Python backends, APIs, system integrations, and automated workflows using AWS serverless and containerized services.

- Engineer Advanced AI Workflows: Build agentic systems using LangChain and LangGraph, covering RAG, tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, custom MCP servers, and reusable internal AI capabilities.

- Ensure Operational Excellence: Establish CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, write infrastructure as code, implement automated testing, and set up comprehensive logging, monitoring (CloudWatch/ELK), and failure recovery.

- Enforce Production Security: Securely manage authentication (OAuth 2.0/SAML/JWT), secret storage, certificates, and strict access controls.

- Set Engineering Standards: Define pragmatic development guidelines for the CTO Office function, document systems clearly, and transparently communicate risks and trade-offs.

## We are looking for you if you have:

- Production Experience: 5+ years of full-stack engineering experience, with a proven track record of independently designing, deploying, and operating software in production.

- Prototype Refactoring Mastery: Strong ability to take unorganized scripts, legacy code, or early-stage prototypes and refactor them into maintainable production systems.

- Frontend & Backend Proficiency: Deep expertise in Python (FastAPI preferred) alongside modern TypeScript/JavaScript frameworks (Vue.js or React).

- AWS & Infrastructure Expertise: Hands-on experience building, scaling, and managing workloads on AWS infrastructure using IaC tools (Terraform/CDK).

- Hands-on Agentic AI Capabilities: Production experience with LangChain, LangGraph, agent orchestration, tool integration, RAG, and error recovery in non-deterministic AI systems.

- DevOps & Automation Mindset: Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), Docker/Kubernetes, and practical experience using modern AI developer tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf).

- High Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to deliver reliably without dedicated QA, DevOps, or SRE teams, navigating ambiguity and challenging unsafe or unclear requirements constructively.

## What’s in it for You

vacancies.description:

In this role, you will work on a large-scale enterprise solution focused on knowledge discovery, AI-assisted communication, workflow automation, and operational efficiency. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform complex organizational processes into intuitive AI-driven experiences.
We at Sigma Software value ownership, innovation, and measurable impact. This is an opportunity to influence product direction, work with modern AI technologies, and contribute to a high-impact initiative with long-term strategic potential.
CUSTOMER
The project is developed for a large enterprise environment focused on improving employee productivity and operational efficiency through AI-driven solutions.
PROJECT
The project focuses on building an enterprise-ready AI assistant that helps employees navigate company knowledge, understand internal policies and processes, draft messages, and automate everyday operational tasks. The platform combines enterprise search, knowledge management, AI-assisted workflows, and agentic capabilities to reduce operational friction and improve employee experience across multiple business functions.

REQUIREMENTS

vacancies.title: AI Product Manager
vacancies.description:
We’re looking for a Product Manager to own AI-driven automation across two connected areas of Precoro’s product: Accounts Payable automation and our new generation of AI agents for procurement document processing.
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who has already taken AI features from idea to production and wants to do it again at scale — across thousands of real customer documents every month.

What you’ll do (responsibilities)

- Own the full product cycle for AI automation: discovery, defining requirements, prioritizing the roadmap, and shipping — from a working prompt to a production feature.

- Work day-to-day with engineering, design, and QA teams to turn AI concepts into shippable features — writing specs, reviewing model/agent outputs, and iterating based on real results.

Accounts Payable Automation

- Increase invoice automation: grow the share of invoices entered fully automatically to a target of 70%.

- Reduce recognition errors: bring down mismatch rates, currently 7% on the US server and 3% on COM.

- Automate custom recognition prompts, building logic that adapts invoice recognition to individual customers’ requirements based on their support tickets.

- Grow key adoption metrics: AP Automation adoption among customers who purchased the tariff plan but aren’t yet using it fully, and AP awareness among users who haven’t experienced the automated flow at all.

AI Agents (Document Intelligence)

- Launch 5 core agents: Intake (creates the purchase request for the user — all they provide is the ask), Purchasing, Matching, Payments, and Data Enrichment.

- Drive agent adoption, embedding them into customers’ real procurement processes rather than leaving them as optional features.

- Drive MCP (Model Context Protocol) adoption across the product.

## Requirements

- Previous hands-on experience implementing AI, either:

- internally, for business process automation — at minimum in reporting or accounting/finance; or

- in a product context — at minimum automating communications.

- Practical experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering.

- A proven track record of shipping AI features into production environments.

- 2+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role working with B2B SaaS products.

## Growth
The scope of this role is a draw on its own — you’d be driving AI automation across one of the highest-volume, highest-impact workflows in the product. Beyond that, there’s a real path to Group Product Manager, based on:

- Measurable results against the metrics above.

- Building a team that can sustain and evolve the product, with a process that’s predictable rather than reactive.

Why you’ll love working at Precoro:

- Trust-based management: No micromanagement—your ideas and initiatives are always encouraged.

- Supportive team culture: You’re not alone, our team is open, honest, and always ready to help.

- Reimbursement for professional learning: We invest in your growth through courses, lectures, and more.

- Flexible hours: We care about results, not how long you sit at your desk.

- 26 days off annually (15 vacation days + 11 public holidays): Work-life balance is a priority for us.

- Medical insurance (after six months)

- Unlimited sick leave without requiring a medical certificate. Your health matters most.

- Pet-friendly offices in Kyiv: Love your furry friend? Bring them along!

- Supporting Ukraine: We proudly assist the Armed Forces and contribute to projects that bring victory closer.

Hiring Process

- Recruiter interview (30–45 minutes)

- Interview with a manager (1 hour)

- Test task (2–4 hours)

- Team interview

Join a team that values trust, transparency, and open communication. You can read more about Precoro’s values at this link.
We foster an environment where everyone is encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive business growth!

vacancies.title: AI Video Creator
vacancies.description:
## About the role
We are looking for a Mid-level AI Video Creator / AI Filmmaker who knows how to turn generative AI tools into complete, engaging visual stories.
This role combines hands-on AI production with cinematic thinking. You will create structured AI-generated video content, from shorter dramatic scenes to experimental projects and longer sequences exceeding five minutes.
You will work within an established creative direction while having significant ownership over how ideas and scripts are translated into finished visual content. We are therefore looking for someone who is comfortable working independently rather than waiting for detailed step-by-step instructions.

## What you will do

- Create AI-generated video scenes, sequences, and complete visual projects.

- Turn scripts and creative concepts into structured visual narratives.

- Produce both shorter scenes and longer AI-driven video projects.

- Combine AI-generated images, video, voice, sound, and music into coherent content.

- Develop pacing, composition, visual continuity, and storytelling based on creative direction.

- Take ownership of assigned creative projects from concept to final output.

- Experiment with new generative AI tools and production techniques.

- Help us improve and streamline our AI content production workflows.

- Collaborate with senior creative leads and work according to established production standards.

## What we’re looking for

- Hands-on experience creating content with generative AI tools.

- Strong experience with AI video generation platforms such as Runway, Pika, or similar tools.

- Experience with AI image generation tools such as Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar solutions.

- Experience incorporating AI-generated audio, voice, sound, or music into creative projects.

- A portfolio demonstrating finished AI-generated video content.

- Good understanding of storytelling, pacing, composition, and visual structure.

- Ability to translate a written script into a visual sequence.

- Experience delivering complete AI-driven creative projects rather than individual isolated assets.

- Ability to work independently and make creative decisions without constant supervision.

- Good English skills, particularly for understanding and working with scripts.

- Experience collaborating with remote creative teams in English.

## Nice to have

- Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro.

- Hands-on experience with AI voice, sound, or music tools such as ElevenLabs, Udio, or Suno.

- A strong interest in experimenting with newly released AI tools and creative workflows.

- Background in film production, advertising, media, video production, or digital content creation.

- Experience combining traditional video production skills with generative AI workflows.

## Who will succeed in this role
You will be a strong fit if you are a self-sufficient creator who can take a script or creative brief and transform it into a complete visual narrative using generative AI.
We are not looking for someone who only knows how to generate individual images or short AI clips. We want someone who understands how separate assets, shots, sound, pacing, and storytelling come together to create a finished piece of content.
Curiosity is equally important. The AI creative landscape changes quickly, so we value people who enjoy testing new tools, finding unconventional solutions, and continuously improving the way they work.

## Portfolio requirement
A relevant portfolio is required.
We would particularly like to see:

- Strong personal or commercial projects created with generative AI tools.

- At least one 1–5 minute AI-generated video, short film, or experimental project.

- An up-to-date portfolio or social media profile showcasing your recent video work.

- A short explanation of your individual contribution and responsibilities for the projects you present.

Please include links to relevant work when applying.

vacancies.title: Backend Team Lead
vacancies.description:
Influence Pro Services розвиває портфель B2C-підписочних продуктів на ринок США та Tier-1. Продукти будуються навколо web2app-воронки: трафік і оплата на вебі, доставка цінності в застосунку.
Ми запускаємо новий продукт приблизно за 12 тижнів — від валідації попиту до перших платних користувачів. Нам потрібен лід, який уже робив це раніше: не підтримував зрілий продукт, а виводив B2C-підписку з нуля в бойовий трафік і потім тримав її під навантаженням.
Це роль з реальним ownership: ти ухвалюєш архітектурні рішення, ведеш команду і відповідаєш за те, щоб реліз відбувся у вікно запуску.

## Що ти будеш робити

- Вести бекенд-команду: планування, оцінки, код-рев’ю, розподіл задач, наставництво, участь у наймі

- Запускати нові продукти з нуля в межах 12-тижневого циклу: від специфікації PM до релізу і перших оплат

- Ухвалювати архітектурні рішення й тримати баланс між «швидко в реліз» і «не переписувати через квартал» — у нас продукт може не пройти гейт Go/Pivot/Stop, і код не повинен бути дорожчим за гіпотезу

- Проєктувати підписочний контур: пейвол, стани підписки, тріали й інтро-періоди, продовження, dunning і ретраї, рефанди, скасування у ARL-відповідному вигляді, мультивалютні й гео-диференційовані ціни

- Тримати web2app-звʼязку на боці бекенду: entitlement, який відкривається і на вебі, і в застосунку, redemption/deep links, ідемпотентна обробка вебхуків Stripe, App Store Server Notifications і Google Play RTDN

- Будувати інтеграції з маркетинговим контуром: серверні події в AppsFlyer, Amplitude, GA4, Conversions API, ESP

- Виносити повторюване у спільний шар: типові рішення підписочного й нотифікаційного контуру мають переюзуватись між продуктами, а не переписуватись у кожному з нуля

- Відповідати за дані: інжест зовнішніх джерел і скрейпінг, черги, ідемпотентність, дедуплікація, дежести й нотифікації за розкладом у кількох таймзонах

- Тримати надійність і собівартість: моніторинг, алерти, SLO на критичні флоу (оплата, доставка контенту), контроль витрат на AWS

- Працювати за нашим SDLC: Definition of Ready / Definition of Done, специфікація від Product перед розробкою, синки двічі на тиждень по перетинних зонах

- Готувати продукт до app-фази: релізи в App Store і Google Play, серверна частина під in-app покупки

## Стек
Наш дефолтний вибір для нових продуктів:

- Бекенд: Node.js + TypeScript (NestJS)

- Дані: PostgreSQL або MySQL, Redis; аналітичне сховище під події за потреби

- Інфраструктура: AWS (ECS/Fargate або Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge), Docker, IaC, CI/CD

- Підписки й платежі: Stripe, Paddle або Solidgate, RevenueCat, App Store Server Notifications, Google Play RTDN

- Продуктовий контур: Amplitude, GA4, AppsFlyer, Sentry, feature flags і A/B-експерименти

- Другий стек: Python — для інжесту даних, скрейпінгу й AI-інтеграцій

Це орієнтир, а не обмеження. Усі продукти будуються з нуля, тому фінальний вибір стека — за лідом: якщо ти обґрунтуєш інший (Go, Python, PHP/Laravel), ми це обговоримо. Ми очікуємо не конкретну технологію, а рішення, яке ти зможеш захистити перед своєю ж командою через рік.

## Що ми очікуємо

- 5+ років бекенд-розробки, з них 1,5+ у ролі Team Lead / Tech Lead із командою від 3х людей

- Обовʼязково: досвід запуску B2C-підписочних продуктів з нуля — мінімум два продукти, доведені до перших платних користувачів і реального трафіку. Це вимога, а не побажання

- Глибока експертиза в одному з мейнстрімних бекенд-стеків для B2C-продуктів (Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Go або PHP) — на рівні, коли ти обираєш архітектуру, а не наслідуєш її

- Реляційна БД на рівні проєктування схеми, індексів, транзакцій і оптимізації запитів. Redis. Черги (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka — будь-що з практикою)

- AWS або GCP: контейнери чи serverless, керована БД, обʼєктне сховище, черги й події, моніторинг. Docker, IaC, CI/CD

- Досвід із підписочним білінгом hands-on: Stripe або Paddle/Solidgate, плюс RevenueCat або власна реалізація. Розуміння, чому вебхуки треба обробляти ідемпотентно і що робить із даними повторна доставка

- Розуміння web2app на рівні архітектури: cross-platform entitlement і redemption-лінки, які відкривають доступ у застосунку після оплати на вебі — ти маєш розуміти цей контур і його підводні камені, навіть якщо збирав його іншими інструментами

- Інтеграції з third-party API як щоденна робота: платіжки, атрибуція, ESP, зовнішні дані

- Досвід інжесту зовнішніх даних: парсинг і скрейпінг, робота з чужими API, черги й планувальники, дедуплікація, обхід лімітів і блокувань. У наших продуктах зовнішні дані — основа цінності, а не допоміжна фіча

- Уміння працювати зі специфікацією і сказати «тут спека суперечлива» до старту, а не на демо

- Англійська Intermediate+ — вендорські API, policy-документи сторів

## Буде плюсом

- Досвід у продуктовій компанії з портфелем продуктів (кілька B2C-апок або web2app-воронок паралельно), а не в одному продукті чи аутсорсі

- Досвід релізів в App Store / Google Play і проходження рев’ю

- Скрейпінг у великому масштабі: власна проксі-інфраструктура, антибот-обхід, тисячі джерел

- ClickHouse або інше аналітичне сховище під події

- Інтеграції LLM/AI у продуктові фічі

- Feature flags і сервіс A/B-експериментів

- Досвід із мультимовністю та RTL на боці бекенду

- GDPR/CCPA, ARL — досвід реалізації видалення даних і скасування підписки за вимогами

## Що ми пропонуємо

- Портфель продуктів і реальні запуски: за рік ти виведеш кілька продуктів, а не один реліз у кварталі

- Ownership архітектури без узгоджень через три рівні

- Технічні рішення у твоїй зоні — твої: стек і архітектуру нового продукту визначаєш ти, а не успадковуєш

- In-house команда: PM, UX, дизайн, motion, маркетинг, growth

- Свобода у виборі AI-стеку та інструментів

- Повністю віддалено, повна зайнятість, 3 місяці probation, 24 дні оплачуваної відпустки після probation, 10 оплачуваних sick days

vacancies.description:
What We Offer

- 100% remote work opportunity and flexitime — choose working hours between 8:00-20:00 Kyiv time.

- Personal Growth Budget in USD (Travel, Health & Psychotherapy, Sports, Education & Training, Software, Work Equipment).

- Competitive compensation in USD with regular salary reviews.

- Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave.

- Continuous professional growth through mentorship, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

- English Speaking Club with a native speaker.

- Access to AI tools, including coding assistants for engineers and LLM subscriptions for non-technical specialists.

- Projects with clients across Europe and North America across FinTech, Logistics, Hospitality, E-commerce, Legal, Music, and other industries.

- Transparent processes, flat management structure, and a supportive team culture.

About the Role

- We are hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to become one of the strongest technical contributors on the team.

- The single most important thing we’re looking for is experience scaling a SaaS product. We want someone who has already seen what happens as a live platform grows: increasing complexity, technical debt, scaling bottlenecks, evolving data models, unreliable integrations, and engineering decisions that worked at one stage but became expensive at the next.

- This is a hands-on senior engineering role with strong technical leadership expectations. You will design and write production code, own substantial systems end to end, influence architectural decisions, challenge technical direction when needed, and raise the engineering level of the people around you.

Project
FinTech SaaS platform built for the restaurant and hospitality industry. Our products handle tip pooling and payouts, payroll, reporting and compliance, labor and operational data, and integrations with the systems hospitality businesses already use. The platform is live, serves thousands of customers and moves millions of dollars.
Required Hard Skills

- Several years operating at Senior Engineer level on a SaaS product that grew significantly while you were there. You have seen a system become meaningfully bigger and understand the problems that tend to arrive next.

- Strong Python and Django / Django REST Framework experience, or deep experience in a closely comparable backend stack.

- Strong React and TypeScript experience, with the ability to work effectively across backend and frontend when required.

- Strong PostgreSQL and data modeling skills. You should be comfortable designing schemas that can evolve as the business grows into new products and safely changing them once they contain production data.

- Production experience with asynchronous and distributed workloads using Celery or comparable technologies.

- Strong understanding of API design and third-party integrations, including failure handling, retries, idempotency, data consistency, reconciliation, and situations where the system on the other side is unreliable or outside your control.

- Strong understanding of software architecture and the ability to make pragmatic architectural decisions inside a large existing codebase rather than only designing systems from scratch.

- Experience identifying and addressing performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability problems before they become critical.

- Strong testing practices and experience safely evolving systems that must remain operational while they are being changed.

- Production experience with Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, error tracking, and observability.

- Strong Linux knowledge.

- Sound judgment about technical debt: knowing the difference between an acceptable shortcut and one that will create significant problems later, and being able to improve a system while it remains in production.

- Everyday experience with using AI agents for work (Claude Code or Codex). Familiar with configuring AI toolset, understanding pros and cons of modern AI.

Current Stack

- Django / DRF, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Docker, Traefik, Datadog, Sentry, Mailgun, GitHub Workflows.

- Next.js, MUI, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Vitest.

Nice to Have

- FinTech or financial systems experience, particularly payments, payouts, ledgers, reconciliation, payroll, banking, audit trails, or other systems where financial correctness matters.

- Experience with restaurant or hospitality technology, including POS, scheduling, workforce management, payroll, or similar systems.

- Experience with high-volume or business-critical third-party integrations.

- Experience improving a system with meaningful legacy code or technical debt while the product remained actively developed.

- Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures.

- Experience improving engineering practices across a team rather than only within your own work.

- Experience as a Senior Engineer in a company of roughly 20–200 people, where your role included helping decide what technical work actually mattered.

Required Soft Skills

- Ability to take technical ownership beyond your own tickets and think about the health of the product and engineering system as a whole.

- Strong engineering judgment and the confidence to challenge technical decisions constructively, including decisions made by Staff Engineers and engineering leadership.

- Comfort with ambiguity. Problems will not always arrive fully specified, and part of your job is asking the questions that make them clear before code gets written.

- Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to engineers, Product, and non-technical stakeholders.

- A strong teaching mindset. You explain your reasoning, document important decisions, review code seriously, and make the engineers around you better rather than becoming the only person who understands a difficult system.

- Comfortable taking leadership during difficult technical situations without waiting for someone else to define every step of the solution.

- Strong written communication and self-direction. The team is distributed across Canada and Europe with limited live overlap, so you need to communicate clearly asynchronously and drive your own work.

- Fluent English, written and spoken.

Key Responsibilities
1. Own substantial systems end to end

- Take meaningful problems that have been identified but not fully solved and work with Staff Engineers and Product to determine the right technical approach.

- Own complex initiatives from problem definition through design, implementation, migration, testing, rollout, and production monitoring.

- Design not only for the expected path, but also for what happens when something goes wrong in production.

- Remain responsible for the systems you build once they are carrying real customer data and real money.

2. Help strengthen the architecture of a growing product

- Work closely with Staff Engineers and the VP of Engineering on architectural decisions and technical direction.

- Understand the existing architecture and identify where today’s decisions may create tomorrow’s problems.

- Identify areas where the platform may struggle as product complexity, integrations, customers, data volume, and transaction volume increase.

- Challenge architectural decisions constructively when you see a better approach.

- Help evolve the architecture incrementally through small, safe improvements rather than unnecessary rewrites or over-engineering.

3. Protect correctness, reliability, and engineering quality

- Treat financial correctness as a first-class engineering concern.

- Design for reconciliation and auditability: how we prove a number is correct, understand how it was produced, and detect discrepancies before customers do.

- Use Datadog, Sentry, logs, production data, and other signals to identify recurring problems and their root causes.

- Improve observability, error handling, testing, deployment safety, performance, and operational reliability.

- Make sure recurring production problems are solved systematically rather than repeatedly patched.

4. Own technically difficult areas of the product

- Lead work involving complex third-party integrations, asynchronous workflows, data synchronization, reconciliation, migrations, and failure recovery.

- Design systems that behave predictably when external APIs fail, requests are duplicated, jobs execute late, or data arrives in an unexpected state.

- Work closely with Product to make technical feasibility and engineering constraints visible before implementation begins.

- Help break large technical initiatives into safe, incremental pieces that can be built, migrated, and released without unnecessarily putting the existing platform at risk.

5. Make the case for important technical work

- Identify technical debt, platform investment, reliability work, and architectural improvements that may not naturally appear on the product roadmap.

- Distinguish between debt that can safely remain and debt that is materially affecting reliability, engineering speed, or future product development.

- Make the business and technical case for that work using evidence rather than engineering preference alone.

- Help sequence improvements so they support product development rather than competing with it unnecessarily.

6. Raise the level of the engineering team

- Be a strong technical reference point for other engineers.

- Review architecture, designs, and pull requests with a focus on correctness, reasoning, and long-term maintainability.

- Explain why you would make a decision differently rather than simply leaving a verdict.

- Mentor engineers through reviews, pairing, technical discussions, and example.

- Document important knowledge and decisions so understanding stays with the team rather than with one individual.

- Take leadership when a difficult technical problem crosses multiple areas or engineers.

7. Remain hands-on

- Design and write production code across the backend and frontend.

- Take direct ownership of technically difficult or risky work when appropriate.

- Debug difficult production issues and establish their root causes.

- Read and understand the existing codebase before changing it.

- Build enough direct knowledge of the platform to ensure your technical decisions are grounded in how the system actually works.

Who this position is not for

- This is not a role for someone whose definition of seniority is simply delivering more complicated tickets.

- If you prefer receiving clearly defined tickets and technical solutions and then implementing them, this role will probably be frustrating.

- It is not a management role. You won’t have direct reports or headcount responsibility. Leadership here comes through technical ownership, judgment, mentoring, reviews, and influence.

- It is also not a Staff Engineer role. Our Staff Engineers and VP of Engineering set the overall technical direction and architecture. You will help shape that direction, challenge it when needed, and fully own the design and implementation of substantial systems within it.

- It is not a greenfield role. You will be joining a live platform with thousands of customers and a roadmap that does not pause while technical improvements are made. Much of the work involves understanding existing systems, migrating them safely, and improving them incrementally rather than replacing them.

- If you naturally ask what happens when the system gets significantly larger, how it fails, how we know the data is correct, and what today’s shortcut will cost us a year from now, you’ll recognize the work.

Things You Should Know Before Applying

- The engineering challenge is no longer simply building features quickly. It is continuing to ship while improving reliability, scalability, architecture, and the technical foundation required for significant year-over-year growth

- There is technical debt. Part of your job is determining which debt actually matters, making its impact visible, and helping address it without stopping product development.

- Requirements will sometimes be incomplete. We expect you to help shape the solution rather than wait for perfect specifications.

- You will be expected to disagree when necessary, propose better approaches, and explain the reasoning behind them.

vacancies.title: Senior Data Engineer — Data Platform & Orchestration
vacancies.description:
## Senior Data Engineer — Data Platform & Orchestration

- Work Format: Full-time; remote

- Department: Data Science

- Reports to: Head of Data Science

- Language: English; working Russian is an advantage

## About Deep Knowledge Group
Deep Knowledge Group (www.dkv.global) builds large-scale analytical databases, investment-intelligence systems, industry ecosystem platforms, competitiveness indices and interactive dashboards across frontier industries including AI, Longevity, HealthTech, DeepTech and QuantumTech.
The Data Science department builds and maintains the industry intelligence databases behind those products — organisations, people, products and the relationships between them, across multiple sectors and regions. Every one of them starts as messy public data and has to end up as a clean, deduplicated, verifiable dataset that analysts and downstream products can rely on.

## About the Role
We currently build each database the way the last one was built. Collectors are source-specific scripts, scheduling is manual, quality is whatever the person who built it checked, and nothing links one database to another. That works at our current size and will not work at the next one.
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to own the shared platform that replaces this: one collection and enrichment framework that every database runs on, with orchestration, monitoring, provenance and entity resolution as properties of the system rather than as things individual engineers remember to do.
This is an ownership role. You will work directly with the Head of Data Science on architecture, and you will be the person other engineers bring design decisions to. We are not looking for an extra pair of hands; we are looking for a second point of technical decision-making in the department.

## Key Responsibilities

- Design and own the shared collection and enrichment framework: what is reusable, what stays source-specific, and where the line between them sits.

- Own orchestration end to end — scheduling, dependencies, retries, backfills, incremental and idempotent re-runs.

- Make entity resolution a permanent service rather than a per-project effort: blocking, matching, thresholds, and a defensible account of why a merge was made.

- Design the provenance model: every value traceable to its source, its retrieval date and the logic that transformed it, six months after the fact.

- Establish the staging-and-promotion rule and enforce it: nothing writes to production tables directly.

- Build monitoring and observability for data, not only for jobs — freshness, coverage, null rates, distribution drift, source schema changes.

- Define the quality standard: accuracy, completeness, duplicate rate, freshness, provenance — and the instrument that measures it.

- Set the schemas, conventions and review standards that the rest of the department works to.

- Design the deterministic backbone of our agent network, and decide where an agent is warranted and where plain code is cheaper, faster and testable.

- Migrate existing databases onto the shared framework alongside the engineers who built them.

- Mentor and unblock other engineers; take architectural decisions off the Head of Department’s desk.

## Required Skills

- Strong Python — you write services and pipelines, not notebooks.

- You have owned a data platform, not just tasks on one — orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, backfills.

- Airflow, Dagster or Prefect in production, with a considered view on why that one.

- SQL and PostgreSQL in depth — indexing, query plans, schema design, migrations.

- Entity resolution or record linkage across sources that disagree with each other, including how you measured whether it worked.

- You have set the standards other people then worked to: schemas, conventions, review.

- Docker, CI/CD, and comfort running production systems on plain infrastructure rather than a managed platform.

- Practical experience with LLM APIs and with validating non-deterministic output before it reaches a production table.

- Data quality discipline: you can state a dataset’s duplicate rate or field staleness with evidence, not by inspection.

- The ability to write a design down clearly enough that someone can argue with it.

## Strong Advantages

- Production collection from public web sources: anti-bot, JS-rendered pages, undocumented APIs, source drift.

- Knowledge graphs, ontologies and canonical entity models across multiple domains.

- Data lineage and governance tooling in production, used by people other than its author.

- Agent orchestration frameworks, and a clear view of their limits.

- Vector search and RAG pipelines.

- Experience turning a team’s ad-hoc scripts into a framework that team then adopted.

- OSINT methodology and source verification.

vacancies.description:
## Job Description: Cybersecurity Specialist
Company: Deep Knowledge Analytics
Role: Cybersecurity Specialist
Location: Remote
Type: Full-time / Contractor

## About the Role
We are looking for a skilled and practical Cybersecurity Specialist to protect our company’s digital infrastructure, internal systems, data assets, cloud tools, websites, email accounts, and operational workflows.
The ideal candidate should be able to assess risks, identify vulnerabilities, secure accounts and systems, improve access controls, monitor threats, support compliance, and create clear cybersecurity processes for a growing analytics and technology-driven organization.

## Key Responsibilities

- Assess the company’s cybersecurity risks across internal systems, websites, cloud platforms, email, file storage, databases, and third-party tools.

- Implement and manage security best practices for Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, cloud services, websites, CRM systems, databases, automation tools, and internal dashboards.

- Set up and maintain strong access control, role-based permissions, password policies, MFA, account recovery procedures, and offboarding processes.

- Conduct vulnerability assessments, security audits, and risk reviews.

- Monitor potential threats, suspicious activity, unauthorized access attempts, phishing risks, malware, and data exposure.

- Support website, application, and infrastructure security, including SSL, DNS security, firewall settings, backups, and server hardening.

- Review and improve security for AI tools, automation workflows, API connections, shared documents, and data pipelines.

- Create cybersecurity policies, incident response procedures, security checklists, and internal documentation.

- Train team members on cybersecurity basics, phishing prevention, password security, data handling, and secure use of AI tools.

- Investigate security incidents and prepare remediation plans.

- Coordinate with IT, development, operations, legal, compliance, and management teams.

- Support compliance with relevant standards such as GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, CIS Controls, or other applicable frameworks.

## Required Skills & Experience

- Experience in cybersecurity, information security, IT security, cloud security, security operations, or similar role.

- Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud security is required (e.g., Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure Security Center, role-based access control, network security groups, Azure compliance tools).

- Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, including access control, MFA, phishing prevention, endpoint security, network security, vulnerability management, and incident response.

- Experience securing business systems such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Notion, Airtable, CRM platforms, cloud storage, and collaboration tools.

- Knowledge of website and application security, including OWASP risks, SSL/TLS, DNS, firewalls, backups, and secure configuration.

- Experience with vulnerability scanning, risk assessment, security audits, and remediation planning.

- Ability to review user permissions, shared drives, admin access, API keys, integrations, and third-party apps.

- Understanding of data protection, privacy, and secure handling of confidential business information.

- Ability to write clear security documentation, policies, checklists, and incident reports.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.

## Nice to Have

- Experience with ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIST, CIS Controls, or other security/compliance frameworks.

- Experience with endpoint detection and response tools, SIEM platforms, VPNs, firewalls, password managers, MDM tools, and cloud security platforms.

- Experience with AWS, Google Cloud, Cloudflare, GitHub, Docker, databases, APIs, and automation platforms.

- Experience with penetration testing, red-team/blue-team exercises, phishing simulations, or social engineering defense.

- Experience securing AI workflows, LLM tools, automation systems, data pipelines, and research platforms.

- Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, CISSP, CISM, CEH, OSCP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), or similar.

- Experience with remote teams and international organizations.

## Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is practical, proactive, and security-minded without being overly bureaucratic. They can quickly identify the biggest risks, prioritize fixes, and implement realistic cybersecurity improvements.
They should be able to protect sensitive data, secure internal operations, educate the team, and build a strong cybersecurity foundation for a company working with analytics, research, AI tools, financial information, and strategic business intelligence.
